marketMood: Risk-off bias: Fed rate-hike fears push the 10Y yield near 4.8%, Strait of Hormuz tensions keep oil above $90, and a BOJ hike signal dragged the Nikkei 2.6% lower—offset only by Dell's AI-driven 16% surge.

topStories.headline: Private Sector Hiring Slows Sharply in August, NFP Friday in Focus
topStories.summary: ADP reported only 38,000 private-sector jobs added in August, well below the 47,000 consensus, setting up Friday's Non-Farm Payrolls as the week's critical macro catalyst.
topStories.marketImpact: Risk assets under pressure ↓; NFP Friday (consensus +55,000) will determine whether Fed hike odds hold at 66%; bonds watch

topStories.headline: Dell Surges 16% on Record $95B AI Server Backlog and Raised Guidance
topStories.summary: Dell Technologies beat Q2 FY2027 earnings with $47B revenue (+58% YoY) and a $95B AI server backlog, boosting its full-year revenue outlook by $25B to ~$192B.
topStories.marketImpact: DELL ↑ 15.76% to $492; Citi and BofA raised targets to $600; positive read-through for AI infrastructure and semiconductor supply chain ↑

topStories.headline: Brent Near $95 as Supertankers Struck in Strait of Hormuz, US Strikes Iran
topStories.summary: Two oil supertankers were struck inside the Strait of Hormuz Tuesday and US airstrikes against Iranian targets continued, with the EIA not expecting Middle East output to recover until early 2027.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ ~$94.86/bbl, WTI ↑ ~$91.85/bbl; energy equities ↑; broad inflation risk weighs on consumer sectors ↓

topStories.headline: Fed Hike Probability Jumps to 66% as 10Y Yield Hits Multiyear Highs
topStories.summary: Markets now price a 66% chance of a 25bps hike at the September 16 FOMC meeting under Chair Kevin Warsh, up from ~40% last week, as the US 10-year yield touched 4.81%.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate-sensitive sectors ↓; USD firming; financials mixed; growth/tech under valuation pressure ↓

topStories.headline: BOJ Governor Ueda Signals September Rate Hike; Nikkei Falls 2.6%
topStories.summary: Governor Ueda told G20 counterparts in Asheville that the BOJ must pay greater attention to upside price risks, cementing expectations for a hike at the September 17–18 meeting; Japan's 10-year yield hit 3% for the first time since 1996.
topStories.marketImpact: Nikkei 225 ↓ 2.60% to 64,495; SoftBank ↓ 6.4%, Tokyo Electron ↓ 3.4%; JPY strengthened ↑; exporters ↓

topStories.headline: Shein Crashes 10% on Hong Kong Trading Debut
topStories.summary: Shein (00625.HK) opened trading Tuesday on HKEX after raising $1.74B at a ~$27B valuation—a fraction of its 2022 peak—and fell 10% shortly after the bell as US tariff headwinds weighed on the fast-fashion retailer's growth story.
topStories.marketImpact: 00625.HK ↓ ~10%; dampens near-term appetite for HK tech IPOs; broader Chinese consumer/retail sentiment watch

topStories.headline: China PMI Sends Mixed Signals: Official Reading Contracts, Caixin Expands
topStories.summary: China's official NBS manufacturing PMI held at 49.8 in August (contracting for a second month), while the private Caixin/S&P Global survey rose to 51.5, highlighting a split between large state-owned and smaller export-oriented manufacturers.
topStories.marketImpact: No clear directional signal; domestic demand sectors soft ↓; AI hardware sub-index within PMI outperformed watch; Hang Seng flat ~25,311

topStories.headline: US ISM Manufacturing Expands for 8th Consecutive Month But Momentum Fades
topStories.summary: ISM Manufacturing PMI dipped to 54.6 in August from July's near-four-year high of 55.6, missing estimates of 55.2, as new orders softened even while production stayed robust at 58.3.
topStories.marketImpact: Broadly constructive for industrials ↑; weaker new orders point to potential Q4 deceleration; consistent with ~2.4% annualised GDP growth
